==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|ready|-ness|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɹɛdinəs/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-readiness.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhyme|en|ɛdinəs|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-|+}}

# The state or degree of being [[ready]]; [[preparedness]].
#: {{ux|en|'''readiness''' for civil emergencies}}
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=5|passage=We expressed our '''readiness''', and in ten minutes were in the station wagon, rolling rapidly down the long drive, for it was then after nine. We passed on the way the van of the guests from Asquith.}}
#* {{quote-web|en|date=26-2-2025|author=Emma Sanders|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c8j0822jp7yo|work=BBC Sport|title='A proper English performance' against Spain|passage=England had won just two of their previous six matches prior to facing Spain and manager Sarina Wiegman had been questioned about their '''readiness''' to defend their European title in Switzerland this summer.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260209184659/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c8j0822jp7yo|archivedate=9 February 2026}}
#* {{quote-web
|en
|date=February 5, 2026
|first=Ben
|last=Blanchard
|title=Taiwan risks becoming numb to China drills, but threat is urgent, defence minister says
|editor=Thomas Derpinghaus
|work=w:Reuters
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260206114304/https://www.reuters.com/world/china/taiwan-risks-becoming-numb-china-drills-threat-is-urgent-defence-minister-says-2026-02-05/
|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/china/taiwan-risks-becoming-numb-china-drills-threat-is-urgent-defence-minister-says-2026-02-05/
|archivedate=6 February 2026
|section=
|text=Taiwanese people are at risk of becoming "numb" to China's daily military and other pressure tactics to wear down the island, but the threat is real and greater '''readiness''' is needed, Defence Minister Wellington Koo said.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}
# [[willingness|Willingness]].
#: {{ux|en|his '''readiness''' to help}}
